description: This file defines the FooTable.Query class used for parsing and testing filter queries in a data table filtering component.

classes.name: FooTable.Query
classes.description: A class for parsing and evaluating filter queries with support for logical operators, negation, phrases, and case insensitivity.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the query object with parsing of the input query string.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the query string value, triggering parsing when set.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Tests if a given string matches the query conditions.

methods.name: _match
methods.description: Internal method to evaluate the parts of the query against a string.

methods.name: _left
methods.description: Evaluates the left side of the query if it exists.

methods.name: _right
methods.description: Evaluates the right side of the query if it exists.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses the query string into logical components and parts.

methods.name: _part
methods.description: Parses a single query part into an object for matching, supporting negation, phrases, and connectors.
